remarks: First run of the notes. It predates timing by section and the name of the provider: the seconds are the wall clock of the whole run, measured from outside. Its notes were found wanting and are not the ones to go by: what the reader knows so far outgrew its limit of 250 words up to 1,284 and then shrank to the last chapter alone, 8 threads of 16 were left open, most of which the book settles, and one character is in the cast under three names.
